concerns.text: Cohen’s d is defined assuming equal variances; the plan states it will use a pooled SD “appropriate for Welch”, which is contradictory. For Welch’s t‑test the standard effect‑size convention is Hedges’ g or Glass’s Δ that accounts for unequal variances. Using a pooled SD here may produce a biased effect‑size estimate.

The borderline‑flag range (p ∈ 0.04–0.06) is defined after Bonferroni correction, yet the corrected α for two comparisons is 0.025. A p‑value in 0.04–0.06 would already be non‑significant under the corrected threshold, making the “sensitive” label ambiguous and potentially misleading.
